acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: The digestion enzyme was set to trypsin and up to two missed cleavages were allowed.

collision_energy.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive mode. MS resolution was set to 120,000, and the top N precursor ions in a 3-second cycle time (within a scan range of m/z 400-1500; isolation window, 1.6 m/z) were subjected to collision-induced dissociation (CID, collision energy 30%) for peptide sequencing.

labeling.evidence: inferred: The Feature Mapper was enabled in PD to quantify peptide precursors detected in the MS1 but may not have been sequenced in all samples.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Mass spectra were acquired on Orbitrap Fusion Lumos coupled to an Easy-nLC1000 HPLC pump (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ptm.evidence: Methionine oxidation and n-terminal acetylation were set as dynamic modifications, and cysteine carbamidomethylation as a static modification.
